title: Embody exact planar K/V ingress transposition
hypothesis: A bounded block transposer can replace synthetic cluster K/V inputs with byte-exact addressed ingress while exposing the buffering, serialization, and backpressure costs that the historical fractional VC0 model omitted.

direct_comparison.primary_question: What functional and physical cost is required to transpose planar 256-bit Llama7B K/V flits into the existing score32 V-fill rows and p53/p54 K staging beats?
include: 32-bit byte-valid mask and disjoint partial-line completion
one 2 KiB paired-stream K transpose target
corrected group-specific p53 and p54 producer/block mapping
cycle and payload equivalence against the canonical Python model
exclude: banked producer-local K staging SRAM and 53/54-way parallel readout
multiple transpose buffers or fill/drain overlap
capacity and HBM gather descriptor scheduler

service_contract.key_output_role: serial producer-addressed write into a future banked K staging store

required_evaluations.objective: Measure Nangate45 PPA of the p53 and p54 one-buffer exact K/V transpose reference.

remaining_abstractions: The serial K output does not embody producer-local staging or simultaneous p53/p54 readout.
A single buffer does not overlap ingress and drain or establish cluster throughput.
Capacity-resident and transient-HBM gather scheduling remain external.
SRAM bitcells and the HBM controller/PHY remain external.
